input.quote: 18.5 Upon the effective date of termination of participation of a Party, Schedules of this Agreement shall be appropriately modified. The remaining Parties to this Agreement shall assume the obligations, capital, operation, and maintenance interests of the Party terminating its participation in proportion to their interests assigned immediately preceding such effective date of termination, except for the continuing rights and obligations of the terminating Party as specified in Subparagraph 18.7 of this Agreement.
input.rationale: Paragraph 18 addresses duration, withdrawal, decommissioning, liquidation of Segments and surviving liabilities (18.1-18.7), and Paragraph 32.6 preserves third-party liabilities, but nothing anywhere requires the other Parties to provide exit or transition assistance or to export/return our data on expiry or termination. Paragraph 31 only imposes a five-year confidentiality tail (p0274) with no return or export obligation, and searches for transition, exit, export, return and deletion language produced no responsive clause. The rule therefore expects a clause that does not exist. We insert a single short Subparagraph 18.8 at the fallback level only: obligations triggered by expiry or termination, not less than ninety (90) days of transition assistance, and export of our data within thirty (30) days. We deliberately omit the preferred six-month/then-current-rates, machine-readable-format and certified-deletion elements to keep the insertion minimal, and flag them as an available upgrade in the comment.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.

proposal.summary: Insert Subparagraph 18.8 giving Teleglobe USA Inc. 90 days of transition assistance and export of its data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 18 deals with decommissioning and asset realization but gives us no exit help and no return of our data, so we have added a short exit provision at our fallback position: ninety (90) days of transition assistance and export of our data within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination. We can discuss the preferred six-month assistance and certified deletion wording if you prefer.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, or upon termination of Teleglobe USA Inc.'s participation in this Agreement, the other Parties shall (i) at Teleglobe USA Inc.'s request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of not less than ninety (90) days following such expiry or termination; and (ii) within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination, export and deliver to Teleglobe USA Inc. all data and information belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Teleglobe USA Inc.
